evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Frames operational safety and capability as contingent on active rehearsal, invoking security (conservation) and verified craft/readiness (competence).

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsIllusory
mints.title: a capability not rehearsed is a capability not actually held
mints.frame: Does the speaker treat safety mechanisms or operational readiness as nonexistent unless actively practiced?
